pairs.target: nài lěi yuē tā dìèrtiān wǔhòu dào jiù lǎn wū , tǎ wéi zǒu dào ménqián , xiān wénjiàn shāojiāo de miàn xiāng , jìnqù cái fāxiàn tā zhèng ná dāo guā guōdǐ .
pairs.english: Nerai invited him to the old cable house the next afternoon; reaching the door, Tavi first smelled scorched bread, and only after entering discovered she was using a knife to scrape the pan's bottom.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾约他第二天午后到旧缆屋，塔维走到门前，先闻见烧焦的面香，进去才发现她正拿刀刮锅底。

pairs.target: tā ràng tā guānmén , bié ràng wūzhǔ wénjiàn , yòu shuō qíshí yǐjīng wǎn le , fāngcái rénjiā qiāo guò qiáng , wèn tā shìbushì zhōngyú dǎsuàn bǎ wūdǐng yě cè yíbiàn .
pairs.english: She told him to shut the door so the landlord would not smell it, then said it was actually too late: the landlord had just knocked on the wall and asked whether she finally meant to survey the roof as well.
pairs.hanzi: 她让他关门，别让屋主闻见，又说其实已经晚了，方才人家敲过墙，问她是不是终于打算把屋顶也测一遍。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng bāo fàngxià , wèn yào buyào bāngmáng , tā shuō bāng tā kànzhe shuǐ , zuǒshǒu diàn zhe bùtuō guō yán , zuìhòu liǎnggēn zhǐtou hái bú dà kěn hé , guō biàn yòu wāi le yíxià .
pairs.english: Tavi put his bag down and asked whether she wanted help; she said to watch the water for her, supporting the rim with a cloth under her left hand; the last two fingers still barely closed, and the pan tilted again briefly.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将包放下，问要不要帮忙，她说帮她看着水，左手垫着布托锅沿，最后两根指头还不大肯合，锅便又歪了一下。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu qiǎng guō , xiān jiāng pángbiān dié de wǎn nuókāi , děng tā fàngwěn , cái bǎ xiǎozào shàng de shuǐhú tídào yòubiān , gěi tā téngchū dìfāng .
pairs.english: He did not snatch the pan, first moving the bowls stacked nearby aside; once she set it steadily down, only then he lifted the kettle from the little stove to the right, making room for her.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有抢锅，先将旁边叠的碗挪开，等她放稳，才把小灶上的水壶提到右边，给她腾出地方。

pairs.target: miànbǐng méi quán huài , liǎng rén fēn zhe chī , tā bǎ jiāo de yìbiān liúgěi zìjǐ , yǎoleyìkǒu yòu zhòuméi , shuō zhè búsuàn niánzhǎng de rén gāi zhàn de piányi .
pairs.english: The flatbread was not entirely ruined; the two shared it, she keeping the scorched side for herself, taking a bite and frowning again, saying this was no privilege that an older person ought to claim.
pairs.hanzi: 面饼没全坏，两人分着吃，她把焦的一边留给自己，咬了一口又皱眉，说这不算年长的人该占的便宜。

pairs.target: qiāoménshēng jiù zài zhèshí xiǎngqǐ , lái de nánrén chuānzhe huò háng de duǎnguà , dài yìzhī xìcháng zhǐtǒng , kànjiàn tǎ wéi , xiān wèn shìbushì yào lìng yuē shíhòu .
pairs.english: A knock sounded just then; the arriving man wore a freight firm's short jacket and carried a slender paper tube; seeing Tavi, he first asked if they should arrange another time.
pairs.hanzi: 敲门声就在这时响起，来的男人穿着货行的短褂，带一只细长纸筒，看见塔维，先问是不是要另约时候。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō zhè shì tóng qù chì píng de xuéshēng , néng tīng , búguò jiālǐ de shì búbì wèn , nánrén biàn diǎntóu , jiāng zhǐtǒng fàngdào zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: Nerai said this was the student who had accompanied her toward Red Flats and could listen, though there was no need to ask about his family; the man nodded and put the tube on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说这是同去赤坪的学生，能听，不过家里的事不必问，男人便点头，将纸筒放到桌上。

pairs.target: tā shì lái tán bǔtú de , huò háng rújīn néng còuchū liǎngmíng hùsòng de rén , ruò tā yuànyì zài zǒu yìhuí , yuàn bǎ xīn yítàng de lùfèi lìng suàn .
pairs.english: He had come to discuss replacing the map; the freight firm could now muster two escorts, and if she was willing to travel once more, it would separately pay the new trip's expenses.
pairs.hanzi: 他是来谈补图的，货行如今能凑出两名护送的人，若她愿意再走一回，愿把新一趟的路费另算。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yànxià zuǐlǐ de bǐng , xiān kàn tā zuǒbì , nánrén yě kànjiàn le , shuō búshì yào tā míngtiān chūmén , zhǐshì yǒu jǐjiā de huò bùnéng yìzhí yā zhe .
pairs.english: Tavi swallowed the bread in his mouth and first looked at her left arm; the man noticed too, saying he was not asking her to leave tomorrow, but several firms' cargo could not remain held up forever.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维咽下嘴里的饼，先看她左臂，男人也看见了，说不是要她明天出门，只是有几家的货不能一直压着。

pairs.target: nài lěi wèn hùsòng cóng nǎlǐ gēn dào nǎlǐ , nánrén zhǐ zìjǐ dài de zhǐ , shuō nánpō dào hé chà , guò le hé chà zànshí méiyǒu rén kěn jiē .
pairs.english: Nerai asked where the escort would join and leave; the man pointed at his paper and said South Slope to River Fork; beyond River Fork, nobody was willing to take over for now.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾问护送从哪里跟到哪里，男人指自己带的纸，说南坡到河岔，过了河岔暂时没有人肯接。

pairs.target: chì píng zài hòutou , tǎ wéi yǐjīng zhīdào , tā yuánběn yǐwéi liǎnggè rén zǒng bǐ méiyǒu hǎo , cǐkè què xiǎngqǐ mǎtóu nà zhāng zhǐ bǎo yíduàn de gàoshì .
pairs.english: Tavi already knew Red Flats lay farther on; he had originally thought two people must be better than none, but now remembered that notice at the quay which covered only one stretch.
pairs.hanzi: 赤坪在后头，塔维已经知道，他原本以为两个人总比没有好，此刻却想起码头那张只保一段的告示。

pairs.target: nài lěi méi lìkè tuīhuí zhǐtǒng , xiān wèn qiánmiàn luòjiǎo de rénjiā shōudào huà méiyǒu , nánrén shuō xīn dé yìzhāng huí tiáo , jiāshàng yuánxiān nà zhāng , zhǐyǒu liǎngchù yǒu zhǔnxìn .
pairs.english: Nerai did not immediately push back the tube, first asking whether the households farther along offering shelter had received word; the man said he had newly received one reply, making only two confirmed places with the previous one.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没立刻推回纸筒，先问前面落脚的人家收到话没有，男人说新得一张回条，加上原先那张，只有两处有准信。

pairs.target: dìèrjiā shuō jìnjǐtiān yǒurén lái wènlù , méiyǒu chūshì , yě méiyǒu shuōlái de shì shuí , tāmen rújīn bú yuàn zài gōngyòng de tú shàng liú jiā míng .
pairs.english: The second household said someone had asked directions in recent days; nothing had happened, nor did they identify the visitor, but now they did not want their family name left on a shared map.
pairs.hanzi: 第二家说近几天有人来问路，没有出事，也没有说来的是谁，他们如今不愿在公用的图上留家名。

pairs.target: nánrén shuō huò háng yào zhīdào yèlǐ néng tíng zài nǎlǐ , bùrán chē dào bànlù , hùsòng de rén yě děi gēnzhe mōhēi , bùnéng dāng lùpáng zǒng yǒu rèfàn .
pairs.english: The man said the freight firm needed to know where it could stop at night, or the carts would get halfway and the escorts too would have to stumble along in darkness; people could not assume hot food always waited beside the road.
pairs.hanzi: 男人说货行要知道夜里能停在哪里，不然车到半路，护送的人也得跟着摸黑，不能当路旁总有热饭。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō zhèhuà búcuò , suíhòu bǎ jiù fùběn fānguòlái , ná yìzhāng kōng zhǐ yā shàng , huà le lùkǒu hé shuǐyuán , què méiyǒu zhàozhe bǎ zhùhù tiān jìnqù .
pairs.english: Nerai said that was fair, then turned the old copy over and weighted it with a blank sheet, drawing junctions and water sources, but did not copy the households onto it.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说这话不错，随后把旧副本翻过来，拿一张空纸压上，画了路口和水源，却没有照着把住户添进去。

pairs.target: tā shuō néng xiān gěi yífèn zǒulù de tú , jièsù lìng wèn , shuíkěn jiē , nǎ tiān jiē , xiěgěi zhè yítàng dàiduì de rén , bù bǎ rénjiā de mén biànchéng rénrén néng zhàozhe zhǎo de jìhào .
pairs.english: She said she could first provide a route map and ask separately about lodging: who was willing to receive visitors, which day to receive them, written for the person leading this trip, without turning a family's door into a mark anyone could follow.
pairs.hanzi: 她说能先给一份走路的图，借宿另问，谁肯接、哪天接，写给这一趟带队的人，不把人家的门变成人人能照着找的记号。

pairs.target: nánrén yòng zhǐtou zài zhuōshàng qīngqiāo , shuō fēnchéng liǎngfèn , sàn duì yǐhòu yòu yào chuán , rén bùkěn kāimén , zhǐ fēn de zài xì yě bùnéng ràng rén shuì jìn wūlǐ .
pairs.english: The man tapped lightly on the table with his finger, saying two separate copies would need passing on again after the group split up; if people would not open their doors, even the finest division of paper could not let anyone sleep indoors.
pairs.hanzi: 男人用指头在桌上轻敲，说分成两份，散队以后又要传，人不肯开门，纸分得再细也不能让人睡进屋里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng xiǎng tì tā dá , nài lěi quèshuō shì , suǒyǐ jīnwǎn bùnéng zài zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng dāying míngrì yǒu chuáng , tā shuō zhè jù shí méiyǒu táigāo shēngyīn .
pairs.english: Tavi was about to answer for her, but Nerai said yes, which was why tonight she could not promise on this sheet that beds would be available tomorrow; she did not raise her voice when she said it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维刚想替她答，奈蕾却说是，所以今晚不能在这张纸上答应明日有床，她说这句时没有抬高声音。

pairs.target: nánrén bǎ zuǐbiān dehuà tíngzhù , guò le yíhuìer , wèn zhèyàngyìlái , yuánxiān bǔquán nà yífèn de gōngqián , tā háiyào buyào zhàoshù ná .
pairs.english: The man stopped the words on his lips; after a moment he asked whether, in that case, she still wanted to take the full fee for completing the original map.
pairs.hanzi: 男人把嘴边的话停住，过了一会儿，问这样一来，原先补全那一份的工钱，她还要不要照数拿。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō méi zuò de bùfen xiān bié suàn , lù tú zuò wán gěi tā kàn , bùnéng wèile ràng qián duì de shàng , xiān bǎ jǐhù rénjiā xiěchéng kěn jiēkè .
pairs.english: Nerai said not to count the unfinished portion yet; when the route map was done she would show it to him, and could not first list several households as willing hosts merely to make the money balance.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说没做的部分先别算，路图做完给他看，不能为了让钱对得上，先把几户人家写成肯接客。

pairs.target: tā shuō de hěn píng , tǎ wéi tīng zhe què yǒuxiē bù shūfú , xiǎngdào zìjǐ nà shíèrméi tuō le jǐtiān de gōngqián , zhīdào shǎodiào de bìng bù zhǐshì zhǐ shàng jǐgè zì .
pairs.english: She spoke evenly, but Tavi felt uncomfortable listening, remembering his twelve coins of wages delayed several days and knowing that what was lost was not merely a few words on paper.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得很平，塔维听着却有些不舒服，想到自己那十二枚拖了几天的工钱，知道少掉的并不只是纸上几个字。

pairs.target: nánrén méiyǒu kuā tā , yě méiyǒu fāhuǒ , bǎ xīn huí tiáo liúxià , dāying huíqù wèn fēn tú de bànfǎ , zhǐ dàizǒu nà zhāng xiě zhe hùsòng qǐzhǐ de zhǐ .
pairs.english: The man neither praised her nor grew angry; he left the new reply, promising to ask about a method for splitting the maps back at work, and took only the paper listing the escort's start and finish.
pairs.hanzi: 男人没有夸她，也没有发火，把新回条留下，答应回去问分图的办法，只带走那张写着护送起止的纸。

pairs.target: mén guānshàng hòu , tǎ wéi wèn tā shìbushì shǎo ná le qián , tā shuō yǎnxià hái méi tán chéng , bié xiān tì tā suàn kuī , yòu jiāng zuìhòu bànkuài jiāo bǐng wǎng tā miànqián yì tuī .
pairs.english: After the door closed, Tavi asked whether she had lost money; she said nothing was agreed yet, so do not count her losses first, then pushed the last half of scorched bread toward him.
pairs.hanzi: 门关上后，塔维问她是不是少拿了钱，她说眼下还没谈成，别先替她算亏，又将最后半块焦饼往他面前一推。

pairs.target: tā méi jiē , wèn tā shénme shíhòu zài chūqù , tā bǎ guōdǐ nà céng hēi jiā guāxiàlái , shuō yào kàn shǒu , yě yào kàn lùshang jiūjìng dāying le shuí , búshì nádào liǎnggè rén biàn néng bǎ shàngcì cādiào .
pairs.english: He did not take it and asked when she would go out again; scraping the black crust from the pan's bottom, she said they would have to look at her hand and also at exactly whom she had promised things along the route, not merely obtain two people and be able to wipe out the previous occasion.
pairs.hanzi: 他没接，问她什么时候再出去，她把锅底那层黑痂刮下来，说要看手，也要看路上究竟答应了谁，不是拿到两个人便能把上次擦掉。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuò le yízhèn , cái shuō zìjǐ xiànzài lián mù tuō yě bùnéng názǒu , tā tái yǎn wèn , jīnrì shì lái tóng tā bǐ shuí liúzài wūlǐ de ma .
pairs.english: Tavi sat a while before saying he could not even take the wooden carriers away now; she looked up and asked whether he had come today to compete with her over who stayed indoors.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐了一阵，才说自己现在连木托也不能拿走，她抬眼问，今日是来同她比谁留在屋里的吗。

pairs.target: tā běnlái búshì xiǎng xiào , zhè yí wèn què xiào le , tì tā ànzhù kōng zhǐ yìjiǎo , ràng tā yòng yòushǒu jìxù huà lùkǒu , chuāngwài yǒurén jiào shōu liàngzhe de yīfu , liǎng rén shuí yě méi xiān dòng .
pairs.english: He had not meant to laugh, but the question made him laugh; he held a corner of the blank sheet for her to keep drawing junctions with her right hand; outside the window someone called for the drying clothes to be brought in, and neither of them moved first.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来不是想笑，这一问却笑了，替她按住空纸一角，让她用右手继续画路口，窗外有人叫收晾着的衣服，两人谁也没先动。
